title: RYPEN 2026
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim organized RYPEN 2026 on 6th and 7th October at Neral Vidya Mandir.
description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Mahim organized RYPEN 2026 on 6th and 7th October at Neral Vidya Mandir. About 70 Students from 7 nearby schools attended the programme along with their teachers. A team of 21 members from RCMM participated in RYPEN.
Invited speakers PDG Dr. Shailesh Palekar, Rtn. Dilip Mulay, AG Rtn. Uday Kulkarni, PP Rtn. Dr. Sameer Tamhane, Rotaract President Anoushka Kulkarni from RC Ruia arrived as promised, catching the infectious enthusiasm to deliver sublime, engaging and interactive discourses. A panel discussion moderated by PP Rtn. Chittaranjan Datar featured seven teachers from the participating schools, a Yoga session led by Dr. Seema Tamhane, a session on the responsible use of digital media by PP Rtn. Vipul Bondal and IT expert PP Rtn. Usha Yegnasheshan, a highly anticipated session with Shri Mahesh Kulkarni providing actionable guidance on preparing for competitive examinations, Mr. Akshay Solanki on stories from his treks and climbs in the mighty Himalayas & so on
location: Neral Vidya Mandir, Neral, Mumbai, Maharashtra
